title: Japan Explorer
description: A 7-day journey through Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka.

days.title: Arrive in Tokyo
days.description: Settle into Tokyo and experience the energy of Shibuya.

activities.title: Arrive and check in
activities.description: Travel from the airport to your hotel and settle in.

activities.title: Explore Shibuya
activities.description: Walk through Shibuya and experience the famous crossing.

activities.title: Shibuya Sky
activities.description: Enjoy panoramic views of Tokyo from the observation deck.

days.title: Discover Traditional Tokyo
days.description: Explore Tokyo's historic neighborhoods, peaceful shrines, and lively local streets.

activities.title: Meiji Shrine
activities.description: Start the morning at one of Tokyo's most peaceful and iconic Shinto shrines.

activities.title: Explore Harajuku
activities.description: Walk through Harajuku's colorful streets and discover its shops, cafés, and local culture.

activities.title: Visit Asakusa
activities.description: Experience one of Tokyo's oldest districts and wander through the historic streets surrounding Senso-ji.

activities.title: Senso-ji Temple
activities.description: Visit Tokyo's famous Buddhist temple and explore Nakamise-dori's traditional shops.

days.title: From Tokyo to Kyoto
days.description: Leave Tokyo behind and begin the next chapter of the journey in Kyoto, Japan's cultural heart.

activities.title: Shinkansen to Kyoto
activities.description: Take the high-speed train from Tokyo to Kyoto and enjoy the changing scenery along the way.

activities.title: Check in and settle in
activities.description: Arrive in Kyoto, check into your accommodation, and take some time to settle into the city.

activities.title: Explore Gion
activities.description: Wander through Kyoto's atmospheric historic district, known for traditional wooden machiya houses and narrow streets.

activities.title: Evening in Kyoto
activities.description: Enjoy a relaxed evening discovering local food and the atmosphere of Kyoto after sunset.

days.title: Kyoto's Timeless Temples
days.description: Discover some of Kyoto's most iconic temples and wander through its historic eastern neighborhoods.

activities.title: Fushimi Inari Shrine
activities.description: Walk beneath the thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up the mountain.

activities.title: Kiyomizu-dera
activities.description: Visit one of Kyoto's most celebrated temples and take in views across the city.

activities.title: Explore Higashiyama
activities.description: Walk through the atmospheric historic streets surrounding Kiyomizu-dera.

activities.title: Evening in Pontocho
activities.description: End the day with dinner and an evening stroll through one of Kyoto's atmospheric dining districts.

days.title: Arashiyama & Kyoto Culture
days.description: Slow down and experience Kyoto's bamboo groves, gardens, and traditional neighborhoods.

activities.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activities.description: Walk through the famous bamboo forest and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the surrounding area.

activities.title: Tenryu-ji Temple
activities.description: Explore the historic Zen temple and its beautifully landscaped gardens.

activities.title: Explore Arashiyama
activities.description: Take your time discovering local cafés, shops, and riverside views.

activities.title: Traditional Kyoto Dinner
activities.description: Enjoy a relaxed evening with local Kyoto cuisine.

days.title: Kyoto to Osaka
days.description: Continue to Osaka and trade Kyoto's quiet streets for the energy, food, and nightlife of Japan's lively second city.

activities.title: Travel to Osaka
activities.description: Take the train from Kyoto to Osaka and begin the final chapter of the journey.

activities.title: Osaka Castle
activities.description: Explore one of Osaka's most recognizable landmarks and learn about the city's history.

activities.title: Dotonbori
activities.description: Discover Osaka's colorful entertainment district and its famous riverside streets.

activities.title: Osaka Street Food
activities.description: Try some of Osaka's famous local specialties during an evening food adventure.

days.title: Osaka & Farewell
days.description: Spend a relaxed final morning in Osaka before wrapping up your Japan adventure.

activities.title: Morning in Osaka
activities.description: Enjoy a relaxed final morning exploring the city at your own pace.

activities.title: Last-minute shopping
activities.description: Pick up souvenirs and enjoy a final wander through Osaka's lively shopping streets.

activities.title: Departure
activities.description: Head to the airport and begin your journey home.
